Hero.subtitle:
I create what others dream of making.
No matter how difficult.
I allways find a way.

intro.paragraph1: I'm {name}, a {role} and UI designer from {country} I like to create stuff that is diffrent from the colorfull gradiently {slop} generated by LLM's.
intro.paragraph2: Each thing I create aims to be creative and unique enough to bring the visitor back. I also love working with people whether in large teams or cozy groups of friends.
intro.paragraph3: Around a year ago, I started working on a free mobile app called {appName}. It's almost finished and you can join the {waitlist} to get to know as soon as it's ready.
intro.paragraph4: Recently I got into {leetcode} and I'm trying to solve a challange per day. It's not easy but I'm learning a lot and I genuinely enjoy solving them.
intro.paragraph5: If you are interested in my work, don't hesitate to contact me - I'll reply as soon as humanly possible.
